svg.title: 6 · fine-line numeral study
svg.desc: Fine-line style adaptation of the verified 6 source outline from Spencerian Key to Practical Penmanship, PDF page 99. The source outline was rasterized at 12 times native resolution, reduced to its medial centerline, and fitted with smooth curves. The original numeral identity and counters are retained. No pressure shades, loops, or numeral forms were copied from the user photograph.
